content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NHAI Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 24-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHAI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application for NHAI Recruitment 2026 is 24 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in NHAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NHAI is recruiting for the posts of Manager (Legal) and Senior Librarian & Information Officer. There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for these positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Manager (Legal) post?
faq.answer: For the Manager (Legal) post, candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Law. A degree in Civil Engineering is desirable. Three years of post-qualification experience in specific legal fields is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to NHAI posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for applying to these posts on deputation is not exceeding 56 years. Additionally, candidates must have more than two years of remaining service as on the closing date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Manager (Legal) and Senior Librarian & Information Officer posts?
faq.answer: Both the Manager (Legal) and Senior Librarian & Information Officer posts are offered at Level 11 in the Pay Matrix, which ranges from Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the NHAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official NHAI website. After filling the form, a printout needs to be forwarded through the parent department along with other required documents.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for NHAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for the NHAI Recruitment 2026. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates regarding fees.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these NHAI posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the NHAI posts typically involves screening based on objective criteria, followed by a written test and/or an interview. The exact process will be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from any state apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, the job location is mentioned as 'Across India', indicating that candidates from all states are eligible to apply for this recruitment, provided they meet the other eligibility criteria.
